ImageDescription.value:
Dartmoor: Cave-Penney Memorial Cross To be found on the south-western slopes of Corndon Tor, the full inscription at the base of the cross reads:

To the Glory of God and to the dear memory of Evelyn Anthony Cave Penney Lieut QVO Corps of Guides fell in Palestine whilst gallantly commanding his men June 8th 1918 aged 19 ---.--- Look up and lift up your heads ---.---

There are recently laid crosses at the foot of the rock.
